rv.q: Once you’ve fallen through the cracks and into a gutter of crime and drug dependency, it argues, it’s impossible to climb back out. Survive and you’ll become a number with a case file and a lack of agency, whose remaining years will be spent pinballing between probation officers and case workers.

It is a thought-provoking production and a strong example of Clean Break’s commitment to using theatre to challenge stereotypes and encourage audiences to reflect on women’s experiences of inequality.
